fields.h1: Build a Recruiting Intake Form for Every Open Role
fields.hero_description: Build a recruiting intake form that gets the must-haves, salary range, and interview panel from hiring managers up front.
fields.features_heading: What the Hiring Manager Answers Once
fields.features_subheading: Describe your roles and who approves them. Emergent builds the form, the routing, and the table your recruiters work from.
fields.feature_1:
Must-haves kept apart from nice-to-haves

Ask the hiring manager for no more than three must-haves, then list the rest as nice-to-haves. Recruiters screen against the short list and use the long one to break a tie.
fields.feature_2:
Salary range and level, asked up front

The form asks for the level, the salary range and whether the role is remote, hybrid, or on site. Each answer is required, so a recruiter knows the budget before the first call.
fields.feature_3:
The interview loop, named before sourcing

List every interview stage, who sits on it and how long it runs. Candidates hear the whole process on the first call, and each panelist knows their slot a week ahead.
fields.feature_4:
Each role routed to its recruiter

Send engineering roles to one recruiter and sales roles to another, by email or in Slack. A role above the salary limit you set waits for an approver before anyone is assigned.
fields.feature_5:
Every intake saved as a record you own

Each submitted intake becomes a record in a database you own, with its team, level, location, and date. Filter open roles by any of them, or list the ones still missing answers.
fields.feature_6:
The full codebase, exported to GitHub

On paid plans, export the full code to your GitHub repository when intakes need to sit next to an applicant tracking system you already run. Host it anywhere and keep building.

faq_plan.q: What is a recruiting intake form?
How do I create a recruiting intake form?

plan.angle: The pages ranking for this term are question lists and downloadable templates for the intake meeting between a recruiter and a hiring manager. None shows what happens after the hiring manager answers. This page shows a working form across four real setups: an agency taking a new client role, an in-house team where high-salary roles need sign-off, a warehouse asking for seasonal headcount by shift, and a recruiting lead watching which intakes are still unanswered. Every intake is saved to a database the team owns.
tab_stories: Bellgrove Search sends each new client an intake link, and when Tilsley Foods plant manager Zofia Szymanska fills it in for a maintenance supervisor role with 3 must-haves, recruiter Edric Lowther gets the whole intake by email.

At Kestrian Robotics, a request for a senior firmware engineer with a salary top of $185,000 waits for VP of People Pernille Aspelund to approve in Slack, because any role over $160,000 needs her sign-off before a recruiter is assigned.
Haverell Freight site manager Arvo Ellory asks for 40 seasonal pickers on one intake, split 24 on nights and 16 on days, and the app opens one request per shift for the recruiting team.

Calloran Software recruiting lead Folarin Okonkwo-Lind sees 14 open intakes in one table, and any intake a hiring manager has left unanswered for more than 3 days gets a reminder, which this week is 2 of them.
